use_when: Use type field to search within one list or page, such as "Search messages", "Search reviews" or the back office "Search" in the header.
Use size md (36px) on web and in the back office; use size lg (44px) in the mobile app for a bigger tap target.
Use type stay at the top of the website and search results to find a stay by place, dates and guests.
Say what is being searched in the placeholder: "Search messages", not just "Search", unless the page makes it obvious.
Show the clear (×) button as soon as there is text, and keep the typed value after the results load.
In type stay, always show a value in each part, such as the dates already chosen, never an empty slot.

dont_use_when.when: To filter by fixed values such as status or property: use Chip filters or a Dropdown.
To type data into a form, such as a name or an address: use a text field.
More than one type stay on the same page.

a11y.fact: The field type is a role="search" landmark wrapping a native <input type="search">, so text entry and focus are the browser's own.
The input is named by the label prop, falling back to the placeholder (aria-label).
The clear control is a native <button type="button"> named "Clear search"; it shows only while the field has text, and focus returns to the input after clearing.
Focus after clearing is returned to the input.
The clear button shows a focus-visible outline in the focus border colour; the field border also turns to the focus colour while the input has focus (focus-within).
The stay type is a role="search" landmark named "Search stays" (aria-label).
The search and clear icons and the stay dividers are hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden).
The stay Search control is the Button component, a native <button type="button">.
